reports.title: Crown Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good on minnows and jigs. Bass are good on crankbaits and jerkbaits.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Greers Ferry Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Crappie are going strong in most places, super shallow out to 30 feet; use minnows, jigs or both.
Black bass are feast-or-famine.
(updated 4-1-2021) Fish ’N Stuff (501-834-5733) in Sherwood says bass are good on drop-shot, shaky heads, jerkbait, Alabama rigs and crankbaits in deeper areas (20-25 feet deep). When fishing shallow for the bass, use spinnerbaits. Crappie are good on Road Runners, Bobby Garland Baby Shad (in pink/chartreuse/white colors) and in shallow depth around the bushes.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Harris Brake Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie remain in the deeper water, but the bite has been good. Black bass are good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Catherine (Below Carpenter Dam) fishing report
reports.text: The crappie spawn has gotten off to a slow start this season, but small catches have been reported this past week in the fast-flowing waters below Carpenter Dam. The white bass and crappie are crowded close together in the tailrace with both species caught over sandbars and rock structure.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Charles fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are fair. Black bass are good. Two weeks ago they had a 48-pound flathead catfish caught on a crappie jig by Frank Bradley.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Dardanelle fishing report
reports.text:
Bass have been good on spinnerbaits, jigs and Bamboozie, lizards and Senkos. A few bass have been spotted on beds in the very back of the warmest pockets. Crappie have been good deep and shallow with the spawn beginning in some of the pockets and backwater areas. Some crappie are still deep; they are biting on Monkey Milk, mayfly, natural colors basically.
Bass are good on white spinnerbaits and white/chartreuse spinners, as well as Jackhammer Chatterbait and black/blue and green pumpkin Senkos in shallow and grassy areas.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Fayetteville fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good on minnows and jigs. Black bass still showed a good bite on crankbaits, while minnows, jigs and Rooster Tails also got decent action.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Hamilton fishing report
reports.text: Bass are blasting a floating worm right now!

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Nimrod fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are good. Black bass are good on spinnerbaits (go with white). The overall catfish bite is good on trotlines baited with bass minnows.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Ouachita fishing report
reports.text: Todd Gadberry at Mountain Harbor Resort and Spa (870-867-2191/800-832-2276 out of state) reports that black bass are very good. Crappie are very good.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Overcup fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are biting well on bass minnows and black/chartreuse jigs, mostly. Bass are good on a variety of baits.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Little Maumelle River fishing report
reports.text: Crappie are fair and continue biting at a 3-4 feet depth; use minnows and jigs. Black bass fell off to fair this week.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Millwood Lake fishing report
reports.text:
* Largemouth bass: Bass have been in a full-blown spawning mode for the past two-to-three weeks on Millwood. Numerous bass beds continue being seen with pre-spawn females staging and spawning. Largemouth bass were improved a little more this week with warmer daytime highs and warm southern winds.
Brad Chronister (right) and his dad, from central Arkansas, caught this bass that weighed between 5 and 5.5 pounds while fishing Millwood Lake with guide Mike Siefert.
Spinnerbaits in white/chartreuse, Millwood Mayhem Bream and Spot Remover caught decent bass this week, and Chatterbaits picked up some healthy 3- to 5-pound largemouths this week. “Most bass we are finding continue randomly roaming…

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Peckerwood Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie fell off some this week to just fair results, on minnows and jigs. Black bass are good on jigs.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: White River fishing report
reports.text: My wife, Lori, had hooked a small long-eared sunfish on Crooked Creek and a big smallmouth had swallowed it.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Beaver Tailwater fishing report
reports.text: If you’re looking for white bass, Kentucky bass or even walleye, you need to be focusing your attention more downstream towards Beaver Town.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: Lake Atkins fishing report
reports.text: When the conditions were right a couple of weeks ago, the crappie were good for anglers using either minnows or Bobby Garland Jigs. Bass were good on plastic worms in size 10 or 12.

reports.source: Arkansas Game and Fish weekly fishing report
reports.title: War Eagle/White River fishing report
reports.text:
Smallmouth bass fishing is great from Huntsville War Eagle accesses downriver to the War Eagle AGFC access, to Smallmouth Rapids north of Hindsville to the War Eagle Mill area – 38 miles of options for kayak and canoe floating with 24 miles of great smallmouth bass fishing! Anglers will also want to know that on the Kings River, from Marble to Marshall Ford to Rock House, the river is running right with some good smallmouth bass fishing!
Spotted bass, drum, catfish and largemouth bass are excellent now.
